{"action":"done","summary":"All 4 acceptance_public tests and 223 upstream tests pass. The existing implementation in tinydb/journal.py already satisfies all requirements R01-R08:

- R01: apply(operations) accepts insert/remove operation dicts, returns inserted IDs
- R02: Atomic batch application with rollback on error (deepcopy storage, restore on failure)
- R03: Ordinary TinyDB operations work, deep copies prevent aliasing of documents
- R04: bool rejected as doc_id (isinstance check before int), structural validation, empty dicts accepted
- R05: preview() returns inserted IDs without modifying data or consuming IDs
- R06: No stale snapshot caching - reads fresh storage each time
- R07: Idempotency token support with ValueError on duplicate token with different operations
- R08: Token bookkeeping internal to BatchWriter, preview doesn't consume tokens

No changes were needed - the existing code was already correct."}
